signIn.googleRowDesc: Continue with the Google account you already use.

profile.title: Profile
profile.signOutDesc: Sign out of your account on this device. Your chats and models stay here.

devices.title: Devices
devices.description: Everywhere your account is signed in.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.deleteDesc: Permanently delete your Atomic Chat account and sign it out everywhere.

delete.title: Delete your account?
delete.description: This permanently deletes your Atomic Chat account and signs it out on every device. It can't be undone. Chats and models on this computer are not affected.
delete.reauthDescription: For your security, sign in again as {{email}} to delete your account.
delete.differentAccount: You signed in with a different account, so nothing was deleted.

toast.sessionLostDesc: Sign in again from Account in the sidebar.

errors.codeExpired: This code has expired. Send a new one.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong codes. Request a new one.
errors.invalidChallenge: This code is no longer valid. Send a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
errors.rateLimitedSeconds_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} second.
errors.rateLimitedSeconds_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} seconds.
errors.rateLimitedMinutes_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
errors.rateLimitedMinutes_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
errors.emailUnavailable: This email can't be used to sign in. Try another one.
errors.invalidRequest: That didn't work. Check what you entered and try again.
errors.reauthRequired: Sign in again to confirm it's you.
errors.signedOut: You're signed out. Sign in again.
errors.unverifiedEmail: Your Google email isn't verified. Verify it with Google, or sign in with an email code.
errors.accountDisabled: This account is disabled. Contact support@atomic.chat.
errors.serverError: Something went wrong on our side. Try again later.
errors.network: Can't reach Atomic Chat. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: Signing in took too long. Try again.
errors.limitReached: That computer already shares with the most devices it can.
errors.alreadyPaired: This device already has access to that computer.
errors.hostNotFound: That computer no longer shares its models.

remote.signedOutDesc: Sign in to share this computer's models with your other devices and to use theirs.

share.title: Share this computer's models
share.description: Your devices signed in to this account can chat with the models on this computer. You allow each device once, and it gets its own key.

reach.internetAndLan: Reachable from anywhere and on your local network
reach.lanOnly: Reachable on your local network only
reach.tunnelError: Remote access failed. Check Server → Remote access.
reach.unreachable: Not reachable yet. Turn on remote access or the local network.
reach.serverStopped: The local API server is stopped.

share.noServerKey: This computer's API has no key, so devices' keys are not checked. Set a key in Server → Configuration.
share.serverFailed: The local API server didn't start, so this computer can't share its models.
share.checkCode: Check code {{code}} — it must match the device
share.keyTitle: Protect this computer's API with a key
share.keyDescription: Sharing checks a key on every request from another device. Atomic Chat will create a key for this computer's API; local tools that use it, such as coding agents, will need that key too.

add.title: Add a device
add.description: On your phone or other computer, open Atomic Chat → Account → Remote models, then scan this code or type it.
add.done: {{name}} can now use this computer's models.

use.title: Use models from your other computers
use.description: Computers signed in to this account that share their models. Once connected, each one shows up as a provider.
use.noHosts: None of your other computers shares its models yet.
use.codePlaceholder: Code from the other computer, e.g. BCDF-GHJK
use.invalidCode: This code is wrong, used or expired.
use.limitReached: That computer already shares with the most devices it can.

toast.request: {{name}} asks to use this computer's models

ended.untrusted: The key from {{name}} could not be verified, so it was refused.
